mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.title, r.status, r.applicant_id, r.approver_id, r.applicant_email, r.created_at, a.display_name AS applicant_name, v.display_name AS approver_name FROM t_request r JOIN t_user a ON a.id = r.applicant_id LEFT JOIN t_user v ON v.id = r.approver_id WHERE r.applicant_id = #{userId} OR r.approver_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.status, r.applicant_id, r.approver_id, r.applicant_email, r.created_at, a.display_name AS applicant_name, v.display_name AS approver_name FROM t_request r JOIN t_user a ON a.id = r.applicant_id LEFT JOIN t_user v ON v.id = r.approver_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND (r.applicant_id = #{userId} OR r.approver_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_request (title, status, applicant_id, approver_id, applicant_email, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{status}, #{applicantId}, #{approverId}, (SELECT email FROM t_user WHERE id = #{applicantId}), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_request SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
